title: 第1章 拜师青云
slug: 掠天记全本免费-掠天记最新章节列表
content_zh:
南澹部州，楚风王朝，天下九大灵脉之一的太行山脉下，青云道门山门前，正有数百名青年人排起了长队，等待着山门前的一个胖道人问询。而此时的队伍前端，则正有一个十岁左右的男童满面泪痕的哭诉着，男童脸很脏，眼睛却甚是明亮，诉声哀哀，惹人怜悯。
胖道人不耐烦的看了小男孩一眼，斜着眼睛问：“你可有荐书？”
“没有……”男童讪讪的答道。
“可有珍宝献上？”
“没有……”
“可有罕见体质？”
“没有……”
胖道人问，男童回答，瞬息三问已过，胖道人瞪起眼睛，一脚将男童踢的滚了两个圈，喝骂道：“没有荐书，便是贱人，没有珍宝，便是穷鬼，没有罕见体质，便是废物，你这一个叫花子也似的穷酸，也敢到咱青云宗前来拜师？瞪大了眼睛瞧瞧，这里可不是救济院！”
后面排得长长的队伍见了这一幕，顿时哈哈大笑了起来。
所有尽皆觉得这男童实在可笑，身无分文，就想来青云道门拜师？
须知道，这青云道门乃是楚国道门，三千年传承，地位尊崇，底蕴深厚，门内弟子随便哪个，都是拔尖的高手，就拿前不久发生的一件事来说，楚域西北，有一窝匪盗横行霸道，为祸一方，就连官府也奈何不得，青云道门真传弟子肖剑鸣得知，便仗一剑，杀入匪盗老窜鬼烟谷，闻名楚域的十大匪盗被他一人一剑斩了九个，只有一个逃脱，立时名震楚域。
也正是因为这一件事，使得青云道门这段时间在楚域平民之中声势益壮，名声无两，如今适逢此道门每十年一次的收徒大典，也不知道多少达官贵人都不惜代价的要把自家的孩子送进道门里去修行，为此有关系的托关系，有珍宝的献珍宝，尽费了一切心思却不得门径。
而这孩子两手空空，跟个叫花子也似，就想前来拜师，实在异想天开。
小男童挨了一脚，却一言不发，默默走到了十丈之后，忽然跳着脚大骂：“我把你个头顶生疮脚下流脓的死肥猪牛鼻子，就凭你那五短身材朝天鼻的丑模样，也敢来骂你爷爷穷酸，老子来你们青云宗拜师是看得你，今天你有眼不识泰山，改天爷爷一把火烧了你们破观……”
“小王八蛋，你敢骂我！”
胖道人大怒，提起了手边的一柄长剑就冲了过去，小男孩则见势就逃，在人群里钻来钻去，身形灵活，胖道人竟然追不上他，气的站在原地，拿剑比划着破口大骂。
原本是端庄肃穆的青云道门收徒大典忽然出现了这样的一幕，顿时引得众人哈哈大笑。
“小爷这样的奇才来你们青云道门拜师是瞧得起你，最好乖乖把我收入门中，不然小爷去了别的道门，修成了盖世神通，一定揍得你们这帮牛鼻子哭爹喊娘……”
小男孩见胖道人追不上自己，顿时得意了起来，牛气轰轰的向着胖道人叫道。
胖道人顿时气的七窍生烟，想要追上前去，此处的人却实在太多，自己身材肥胖，无法轻易突破，但他忽然眼珠一转，有了计较，高声叫道：“谁帮我拿下这小子，容他先报名……”

听了此言，小男孩大吃一惊，转身就要溜。
但身边等着报名之人听了，却顿时有不少人冲上前来擒他。这些人都是等着报名的，只可惜一条窄窄山道，却有不下数千人来报名，排了大半天也不见队伍向前挪一挪，听了胖道士的话，自然忍不住心动，随手把帮擒下这个小滑头，却能省掉自己排队之苦。
更有人想，哪怕省去排队之苦，也没什么，能提前交好这道门弟子，才是最重要的。
小男孩身形竟然滑溜之极，四五个青年抓他都没抓住，眼见这里一钻，那里一跳，就要逃出人群包围，忽然人群里一个脸色白净瘦削，目光阴冷的年青人闪身跳了出来，冷笑道：“身上竟然还有功夫，可惜不够瞧的！”说着探手抓出，揪着小男孩的后领将他提了起来。
小男孩奋力挣扎，在这年青人手里却逃无可逃，仿佛被捏住了七寸的小蛇。

content_en:
In Nandanbu Prefecture, under the Chufeng Dynasty, under the Taihang Mountains, one of the nine major spiritual veins in the world, hundreds of young people were lining up in front of Qingyun Daomen Mountain, waiting to be questioned by a fat Taoist in front of the mountain gate. At this time, at the front of the team, there was a boy about ten years old crying with tears on his face. The boy's face was dirty, but his eyes were very bright. His voice was pitiful and pitiful.
The fat Taoist glanced at the little boy impatiently, squinted and asked, "Do you have any recommendations?"
"No..." the boy replied nonchalantly.
"Do you have any treasures to offer?"
"No..."
"Do you have a rare physique?"
"No..."
The fat Taoist asked, and the boy answered. After three questions, the fat Taoist stared, kicked the boy and rolled him twice, and cursed: "If you don't have a recommendation book, you are a bitch, if you don't have a treasure, you are a pauper, if you don't have a rare physique, you are a waste, you are as poor as a beggar, how dare you come to our Qingyun Sect to become a disciple? Open your eyes wide and see, this is not a workhouse!"
The long queue behind them burst out laughing when they saw this scene.
Everyone thinks this boy is really ridiculous. He is penniless and wants to come to Qingyun Taoism to become a disciple?
You must know that this Qingyun Taoist sect is a Taoist sect of the Chu State. It has a three-thousand-year heritage, a respected status, and a profound foundation. Any disciple in the sect is a top-notch master. Take an incident that happened not long ago. In the northwest of the Chu region, there was a group of bandits running amok. Xiao Jianming, a true disciple of the Qingyun Taoist Sect, learned that this was a disaster, so he entered the Ghost Smoke Valley where the bandits were hiding. He killed nine of the ten famous bandits in the Chu region with one sword, and only one escaped. He immediately became famous in the Chu region.
It is precisely because of this incident that the Qingyun Taoist Sect has grown in power and reputation among the common people in the Chu region during this period. Now it is the Taoist sect's disciple recruitment ceremony every ten years. I don't know how many dignitaries want to send their children into the Taoist sect to practice at any cost. For this purpose, they have trusted relationships and offered treasures. They have tried their best but can't find the way.
But this child has nothing in his hands, just like a beggar, and he wants to come and become a disciple, which is really crazy.
The little boy received a kick but said nothing. After walking ten feet in silence, he suddenly jumped on his feet and cursed: "I gave you a dead fat pig with a nose with sores on your head and pus on your feet. You dare to scold your grandpa for being poor just because of your short stature and upturned nose. I came to your Qingyun Sect to become a disciple because I saw you. Today you are blind and can't see Mount Tai. Another day grandpa will burn you Pokanan..."
"You little bastard, how dare you scold me!"
The fat Taoist was furious, picked up the long sword at hand and rushed over. The little boy ran away when he saw the situation, and wormed his way through the crowd. His body was so flexible that the fat Taoist couldn't catch up with him. He stood there angrily, gesturing with his sword and yelling curses.
The originally dignified and solemn Qingyun Taoist Disciple Recruitment Ceremony suddenly had such a scene, which immediately caused everyone to laugh.
"A prodigy like me comes to your Qingyun Taoist sect because I think highly of you. You'd better accept me into your sect. Otherwise, if I go to another sect and develop unparalleled magical powers, I will definitely beat you guys to the point of crying for your father and mother..."
When the little boy saw that the fat Taoist could not catch up with him, he suddenly became proud and shouted at the fat Taoist in an arrogant manner.
The fat Taoist was so angry that he wanted to catch up, but there were too many people here. He was fat and couldn't break through easily. But he suddenly rolled his eyes, had a plan, and shouted loudly: "Who can help me capture this kid? Let him sign up first..."
After hearing this, the little boy was shocked and turned around to run away.
But when the people around him who were waiting to sign up heard this, many people rushed forward to capture him. These people were all waiting to sign up, but it was a pity that there were no less than thousands of people signing up on a narrow mountain road, and even after waiting in line for most of the day, there was still no queue.Wu moved forward, and after listening to the fat Taoist priest's words, he couldn't help but feel excited. He casually captured this little naughty guy, but he could save himself the pain of queuing up.
Some people even think that even if they save themselves the pain of queuing, it doesn't matter. Being able to make friends with this disciple in advance is the most important thing.
The little boy was so slippery that even four or five young people couldn't catch him. He was about to escape from the crowd as he swung here and there, but suddenly a young man with a fair complexion and cold eyes jumped out from the crowd and sneered: "There is still some kung fu in him, but it's a pity that it's not enough!" He reached out and grabbed the little boy by his collar and lifted him up.
The little boy struggled hard, but he couldn't escape in the young man's hands, as if he was a seven-inch snake.
